name: Hinatsuru Ai
source:
Yaichi's first disciple, a nine-year-old third grader. She is a cheerful girl with extreme talent for shogi, as well as the daughter of the owners of a large and popular inn which has been the site for major matches in Ishikawa. She holds great admiration for Yaichi for his determination and refusal to give up after witnessing his Ryuuou match.

[Taken from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Ryuo%27s_Work_is_Never_Done!]Wikipedia[/url]]
